evidence: A valid settlement can reject current-form approval, set 90 publication-review days, prohibit patient-data transfer, require processing in the company's controlled environment, grant exclusive clinical-diagnostics rights while retaining rights in other fields, include matching amendment commitments, and reveal and justify PF1. A settlement relying only on shared facts could retain 60 days, permit data transfer, and keep broad nonexclusive rights, thereby failing multiple checks.
